_comment: Teams ConfigAPI routes outside /Skype.Policy/configurations, reached via New-TeamsRequestV2 -Path. Verified live against aspendora.com on 2026-09-13 unless marked otherwise. 'verified' records what a live GET actually returned: 200 = reachable, 401 = exists but denied to CIPP's token (Microsoft-internal support surface), 404 = no such route.

routes.description: Call queues with full routing, overflow, timeout, agent and voicemail configuration.
Auto attendants: call flows, menus, prompts, holidays.
Business-hours and holiday schedules used by auto attendants.
Which resource account is associated with which call queue / auto attendant.
Languages available for voice app prompts.
Timezones available for voice app schedules.
Resource accounts (application instances) backing call queues and auto attendants. Already used by Set-CIPPDBCacheTeamsResourceAccounts.
Emergency (LIS) locations. Already used by Get-CippTeamsLocationLookup.
Group policy assignments. Returns null when none are configured.
Status of batch/group policy assignment operations.
Tenant info plus serviceDiscovery (ConfigApiEndpoint, AdminServiceEndpoint, X-MS-Forest) and the full assignedPlans list.

denied.note: Microsoft-internal support read. 401 persists with service discovery AND with x-ms-target-uri/x-ms-tenant-id headers. Use Skype.Policy/groupPolicyAssignments instead.
Microsoft-internal support routes from CmdletSettings.json. Not customer-accessible.

notFound._note: No per-user policy-assignment REST route exists on the customer ConfigAPI surface. Grant-Cs* in the MicrosoftTeams module rides the OCE remote-PowerShell path (admin<forest>.online.lync.com/OcsPowershellWebservice) - the surface New-TeamsRequestV2's own docs record as 40301 Forbidden under CSP/GDAP. See docs/teams-management-build-progress.md Phase 2.
